title: Q-KIT-INTENT-YIELD-1: carry INTENT-YIELD-1 into the seed kit
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation systemspec --rule INTENT-YIELD-1
**Status:** closed

SYSTEM-SPEC-1: the standing rule INTENT-YIELD-1 is enforced only by the platform. A system built from the seed inherits the rule as an instruction but has no code in the kit that enforces it.

Ship the check or loop that enforces INTENT-YIELD-1 into seed/ (a script under seed/scripts/, a tick step under seed/worker/src/, or a test under seed/tests/), add its probe to kit_enforcement in seed/autonomy/system.json, and remove INTENT-YIELD-1 from not_in_kit.

Prediction: kit_rules_not_enforced <= 16 within 168 h

**Out of scope:** changing the rule's wording in agents/AGENTS.md, or moving the platform's own check out of foundation/.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation systemspec --rule INTENT-YIELD-1` exits 0: the spec holds and INTENT-YIELD-1 is enforced inside the kit.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T04:03:04Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
